prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, website hero asset.
Create a premium photorealistic 3D product illustration for a restrained modern Chinese enterprise cloud infrastructure brand. A sculptural translucent cobalt-blue optical-glass cloud floats just above a precision-machined white ceramic server platform with two shallow stacked levels, subtle brushed-silver edges, one discreet cobalt light detail, and a few elegant clear optical-fiber curves around the base. The cloud is the single bold focal object, tactile, beautifully made, and readable at small scale. Realistic glass refraction and reflections, soft daylight, high-end product photography, smooth white to very pale ice-blue studio backdrop. Crisp silhouette, refined proportions, minimal shadow, airy negative space. Landscape 3:2 composition, approximately 1536 by 1024. Place the complete sculptural object around the middle-right, leaving uncluttered space and generous margins; all of the object remains visible and uncropped. This image will occupy the right half of a clean web homepage; it must blend into a near-white background. Restrained Apple-quality industrial art direction, contemporary and precise. No text, no words, no labels, no logos, no interface, no purple, no red, no neon, no starfield, no dramatic fog, no heavy glow, no dark background, no busy circuit-board patterns.
